name: dropdown-menu-form
title: Dropdown Menu Form
description: The parts a DropdownMenu needs to hold a small form — a text input that keeps its keys, a switch row with a hint, and a menu that opens at a point instead of under a trigger.

meta.whenToUse: A menu that carries an input, a setting switch, or opens where the pointer was (a column header's field menu).
meta.whenNotToUse: A form of several fields (a Popover or a Dialog with Field).
